narrative:
The consolidated management P&L lands at GBP 203M operating profit, up 14% on FY2025/26 and within 5% of the GBP 210M Board target. Cost-to-sales improves to 29.7%, inside the 30% ceiling.

Sales volume and margin rate add GBP 100M. Partner pay, distribution, technology and estate depreciation take GBP 118M. Head office simplification and occupancy savings add back GBP 43M.

The whole pack is produced from one governed model in Snowflake. 38 of the 42 PMIS Excel workbooks are retired; the remaining four are John Lewis branch-level schedules that wait on foundational data work, starting Waitrose-first as agreed after DCNRT.

signals.title: PMIS still mastered in Excel
signals.excerpt: Management income statement, budget, forecast and cash flow live in spreadsheets. Reporting-line definitions exist only in workbooks, so every cycle re-reconciles the same numbers.

signals.title: Lessons from DCNRT
signals.excerpt: A prior finance data project did not deliver. Waitrose-first phasing on data already in Snowflake de-risks the next step.

signals.title: Meter Programme — 5 legacy data platforms into Snowflake
signals.excerpt: Consolidating BigQuery, Teradata, SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL estates onto Snowflake. Oracle Finance (CDC), Kooper and DIDOS already landed but under-used by Finance.
